answer: One strong defence is a stake-bonded identity thread: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, so a Sybil attacker pays per fake identity and a gale of sockpuppets drains their own funds instead of the commons. Honest agents get the stake back, while misbehaviour slashes it; the deposit acts like shale under a foundation — cheap to stand on once, ruinously expensive to fake a thousand times.
